description: Implementation of a service class for retrieving non-closed loan IDs and related COB (Close of Business) data in the Fineract project, including database query methods and data filtering based on loan statuses and business dates.

classes.name: RetrieveAllNonClosedLoanIdServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to retrieve non-closed loan IDs and COB-related data, using JDBC and repository queries.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCOBPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves paginated COB partitions for loans based on status and business date, constructing a SQL query dynamically.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a COBPartition object.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDate
methods.description: Fetches loans behind a specific business date filtered by loan IDs and statuses.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDateOrNull
methods.description: Fetches loans behind a specific business date or with null last closed date, filtered by loan IDs and statuses.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsOldestCobProcessed
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest COB processed loans for a given business date.

methods.name: retrieveAllNonClosedLoansByLastClosedBusinessDateAndMinAndMaxLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed loans within a specified ID range and business date, considering catch-up mode.

methods.name: findAllStayedLockedByCobBusinessDate
methods.description: Finds all loans that are stayed locked on a specific COB business date.
